Boundaries used for the NYC geography crosswalks

Source: R/data.R
nyc_xwalk_boundaries_sf.Rd

The boundaries of the fifteen geographies, as downloaded and combined to compute the crosswalk tables. EPSG:2263, NAD83 / New York Long Island (ftUS).

Usage

nyc_xwalk_boundaries_sf

Format

nyc_xwalk_boundaries_sf

A simple feature collection with 1,155 rows and 4 columns:

geo_id

Geography ID (character). See nyc_xwalk_geographies_df.

geo_name

Feature name, as in the crosswalk tables (character).

geo_name_alt

Alternate name (character). The district code for sanitation districts and the NTA code for NTAs. NA for the other geographies.

geometry

Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry in EPSG:2263.

Source

See nyc_xwalk_geographies_df for the source and release of each geography.

Details

The features are as published, not dissolved. One school district has two features with the same name, and the crosswalks treat them as one feature. nycbuildxwalks repaired invalid geometries with GEOS in planar coordinates. The Historic Districts source labels State Plane coordinates as longitude and latitude. nycbuildxwalks 0.0.0.9001 detects this label and relabels the coordinates as EPSG:2263.

Several of these geographies are not in the nycmaps package: business improvement districts, historic districts, industrial business zones, fire battalions, sanitation districts, and health center districts. nyc_xwalk_df gives the credits for the crosswalk method.
